title: Organize and reveal map objects
summary: Use saved layers and brush groups, temporary visibility, filters, and statistics.
outcome: You can focus on one part of a busy map and find objects that appear to be missing.

sections.title: Put objects in layers or groups

steps.title: Assign a layer
steps.text: Select objects, open Organize > Layers, groups and visibility…, create a layer or choose one, then click Assign selection. A slash in a layer path creates a hierarchy.

steps.title: Find or protect the layer
steps.text: Choose a layer and click Select layer, Hide layer, or Freeze layer. Clear Hide or Freeze to make its contents visible or selectable again.

steps.title: Group world geometry
steps.text: Select world brushes or terrain patches, enter an optional group name, and click Group. Use Select or Ungroup on a chosen group.

paragraphs: Layers and brush groups are saved with the map. Layers also cover point entities and prefab instances; grouping is for selected world brushes and terrain patches.

sections.title: Narrow the view temporarily

steps.title: Hide, isolate, or freeze
steps.text: With objects selected, use Hide, Isolate, or Freeze under Selection visibility. Click Restore selection visibility to clear these temporary choices.

steps.title: Filter by category
steps.text: Use View > Quick visibility to toggle brushes, patches, models and prefabs, or entities. Open View > Filters… for more specific display filtering.

steps.title: Check the map
steps.text: Open View > Map statistics… to inspect counts without changing map content.

tips: If an object seems gone, check its layer, temporary selection visibility, Quick visibility, and Filters before recreating it.
